definitions.full: H1043. Beth -anath בֵּיתעֲֿנָת proper name, of a location in Naphtali ( temple of `Anât Nes Eg 114 Bae Rel 53 Mey ZMG 1877, 718 ) Josh 19:38 ; Judg 1:33 ; ע ׳בֵּית 1:33 ; — perhaps modern Ain-Ata see d. Velde Narr. i. 170 , 6 miles west of Kedesh (name `Anata Guérin Gal. ii. 374 ; `Ainîtha , Survey i. 200 ).

occurrences.englishText: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.
